clue.text: Agent snatching short sleep without hesitation

indicators.note: an agent snatching something holds it within his grasp, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: A secret agent grabs a quick doze the moment he gets the chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something snappy is brisk and quick, done promptly with no pause or delay.

clue.text: Abrasive extremes from sharp impressionist

parts.note: the ends of sharp are S and P, spelt out as S AND P
an aper is one who apes, a mimic

explanation.surface: Harsh edges from a pointed painter of light.
explanation.walkthrough: The outer letters of 'sharp' are S and P, and the clue spells the 'and' out. 'Impressionist' wants to be Monet, but here it is a mimic.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandpaper is an abrasive paper used to smooth surfaces.

clue.text: Pale woman featuring in article

indicators.note: the woman features inside the other piece

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
she stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A wan lady is the subject of a magazine piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashen means pale as ash, drained of colour.

clue.text: From oil transporter, spot East River rising

parts.note: a pip is a spot, as on dice or cards

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the Nile is the great African river

explanation.surface: Spotting oil flowing up an eastern river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns E and NILE together into ELINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipeline is a long pipe carrying oil over distance.

clue.text: Very narrow opening for hopeful travel operator

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, taken here from hopeful

parts.note: an airline is a company operating air travel

explanation.surface: A slim chance of a start for an optimistic tour company.
explanation.definitionFit: Hairline is used adjectively for anything extremely thin, as in a hairline crack.

clue.text: Ultimately exhausted, getting personal bio best in race, say

parts.note: all in means exhausted

parts.words: personal bio best in race, say
parts.note: a personal best in a race is an example of a fast finishing time; the stray bio looks like an OCR artefact

explanation.surface: A runner is finally spent after setting a personal best.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' joins the two halves; 'Ultimately' at the front is the definition, not a last-letter signal.
explanation.definitionFit: All in good time means eventually, in due course, as ultimately does.

clue.text: Read out liturgy around city

indicators.note: the liturgy goes around the city

parts.note: a rite is a liturgical ceremony
EC is the postal district of the City of London

explanation.surface: Reading the service aloud all over town.
explanation.definitionFit: To recite is to say aloud from memory, to read out.

clue.text: Currently successful soldier is source of dope

parts.note: in form means currently doing well
a soldier ant is a kind of ant

explanation.surface: A winning soldier turns out to be the drugs supplier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like drugs but means information.
explanation.definitionFit: An informant supplies information, and dope is slang for inside information.

clue.text: Lots of old information turning up about name in register

indicators.note: the old information goes about the name
in a down clue turning up reads the letters bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: lore is a body of traditional knowledge

explanation.surface: Ancient archives being dug up and listed in a register.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrol is to enter on a register or list.

clue.text: Someone unable to comprehend an erroneous description of Pandora's box?

definitions.text: Someone unable to comprehend an erroneous description of Pandora's box?

parts.words: Someone unable to comprehend an erroneous description of Pandora's box?
parts.note: a person with no chance of success; read playfully, it would describe a container lacking hope, which Pandora's box was not, since hope stayed inside it

explanation.surface: A dim person misunderstands the Greek myth of Pandora's box.
explanation.walkthrough: In the myth, when Pandora opened the box all the evils escaped but Hope remained inside, so calling it hopeless is the erroneous description.
explanation.definitionFit: A person with no hope of success is a hopeless case, slangily a loser with no prospects.

clue.text: Approximate description of hooligan with money?

parts.note: a rough is a hooligan
and means with
the ready is slang for cash

explanation.surface: A rough sketch of a thug with cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough and ready means crude but adequate, roughly approximate.

clue.text: Match spreading fire? Reduced chance up front

indicators.note: the reduced chance is placed at the front of the other piece
reduced means cut short, so the final letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: luck is chance

indicators.note: fire spreading has its letters scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A match starting a blaze, with luck playing a part from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Match' looks like a contest, but it is the old friction match; 'up front' places the shortened chance ahead of the scrambled fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucifer was an old name for a friction match, struck to light a flame.

clue.text: Group of experts criticise Spanish article

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
el is the Spanish definite article

explanation.surface: A gathering of specialists attacks a piece of writing from Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel is a small body of specialists convened to judge or discuss something.

clue.text: Sharp or flat? That's not normal

definitions.meaning: in music a note raised or lowered is not a natural, so is jocularly not natural
abnormal, contrary to the ordinary course of nature

explanation.surface: A singer off pitch is told this is not how things should be.
explanation.definitionFit: Unnatural means abnormal, and punningly a note that is not a natural in music.

clue.text: With issue to raise, one's in such a state

definitions.text: With issue to raise, one's in such a state

parts.words: With issue to raise, one's in such a state
parts.note: issue here means offspring; someone with children to bring up is in the condition of being a mother or father

explanation.surface: Someone with a problem to bring up is in a right state about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' looks like a problem to raise at a meeting, but it means children, and 'raise' means bring up.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being a mother or father, raising children, is this condition.

clue.text: Alien, amidst others, went ahead and found new home

indicators.note: the alien sits amid the others

parts.note: the rest are the others
ET is the film alien
led means went ahead

explanation.surface: An alien among the crowd led the way and settled somewhere new.
explanation.definitionFit: Resettled means moved to a new home, so found new home fits.

clue.text: Fine performance is a matter of record

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
an act is a performance

explanation.surface: A good show goes down in the record books.
explanation.definitionFit: A fact is something established and on record as true.

clue.text: Newly-made bed ready?? Time to go up — with this?

definitions.text: Newly-made bed ready?? Time to go up — with this?

indicators.note: in a down clue going up puts the letter at the top, before the rest
the letters of bed ready are made anew, rearranged

explanation.surface: A child's bed is made: time to go upstairs with a cuddly companion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Newly-made' anagrams BED READY to EDDYBEAR; 'to go up' puts T at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: A child takes a cuddly toy bear up to bed at bedtime.

clue.text: Old fighter pilots maintaining height

indicators.note: maintaining means holding, so the pilots hold the height inside

parts.note: aces are expert fighter pilots
a hill is a height

explanation.surface: Veteran fighter pilots keep their altitude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fighter' suggests a plane; it is the Greek warrior of the Trojan War.
explanation.definitionFit: Achilles was the great Greek warrior at Troy, an ancient fighter.

clue.text: Crowd not beginning to hurry

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter, its beginning

parts.note: a crush is a dense crowd

explanation.surface: Large crowds are told not to start pushing to get in.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush is to hurry or move with haste.

clue.text: Not having benefited from the class system?

definitions.text: Not having benefited from the class system?

parts.words: Not having benefited from the class system?
parts.note: suggests missing out on social privilege, but class means a school lesson: someone who never had schooling

explanation.surface: A complaint about losing out under Britain's social hierarchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Class system' suggests the British social hierarchy; here it means school classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has had no schooling has not benefited from lessons in class.

clue.text: Make use of library for writer of gypsy book

definitions.meaning: to take out a book on loan
George ... wrote Lavengro and The Romany Rye about gypsy life

explanation.surface: A library user discovers the author of a Romany tale.
explanation.definitionFit: To borrow is to take on loan, and George Borrow wrote about gypsies.

clue.text: Drug flow leads to remarkable increase in dried leaves

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
to pour is to flow

indicators.note: the leads of words are their first letters, here of remarkable and increase

explanation.surface: Cannabis use is said to cause a striking rise in dried foliage.
explanation.definitionFit: Potpourri is a scented mixture of dried petals and leaves.

clue.text: Golfing standards involving one in now golfing matches

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: par is the standard score for a golf hole
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Golf scores feature in a series of golfing contests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in now golfing' reads as linking in the held text.
explanation.definitionFit: Pairs are matching sets of two, so matches fits as a noun.

clue.text: Suggest just refusing to start

indicators.note: the word declines its start, so it loses its first letter

parts.note: simply means just, as in just or simply wrong

explanation.surface: Hinting that someone merely won't get going.
explanation.definitionFit: To imply something is to suggest it without stating it outright.

clue.text: I learn part of my anatomy

definitions.meaning: a learner, a schoolchild, might say this of themselves
the dark opening at the centre of the eye

explanation.surface: A student is studying human anatomy.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil is both a school learner and the opening in the iris of the eye.

clue.text: Shakespearean setting badly affected by atmosphere, on reflection

parts.note: illy is an old adverb meaning badly

indicators.note: reflected like an image in a mirror, the word is read backwards

parts.note: air is atmosphere

explanation.surface: A Shakespeare scene ruined by its mood, when you think about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected by' is linking. ILLYRIA is the setting of Twelfth Night.
explanation.definitionFit: Illyria, on the Adriatic, is the setting for Shakespeare's Twelfth Night.

clue.text: Black out film extracts about drug repeatedly? On the contrary

indicators.note: one piece goes around the other; 'On the contrary' says it is the drug that goes around the extracts, not the other way
the drug letter is given twice over

parts.note: E is short for the drug ecstasy
clips are short extracts from films

explanation.surface: Film clips about drug-taking are suppressed, or rather the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue says extracts about drug, then 'On the contrary' flips it: E and E go around CLIPS.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse is to block out light, so black out fits as a verb.

clue.text: Teams straddling path laterally

indicators.note: straddling means standing astride, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: sides are teams
a way is a path

explanation.surface: Two teams line up either side of a footpath.
explanation.definitionFit: Sideways and laterally both mean towards or from the side.

clue.text: Inn servant had role to play over the way

indicators.note: in this across clue the rearranged letters lie over, covering, the other piece
letters given to play with are set into a new order

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: An innkeeper's man was given a part to act across the road.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'over' cannot mean above, so it means covering on both sides, with 'the way' sitting inside the scrambled role.
explanation.definitionFit: An ostler was a stableman who looked after horses at an inn.
